g.desc: Kill loop (normally closed: open = motors cut) and CPX backup kill

g.text: Fit a shorting plug, a remote-kill relay contact or a NC button in J KILL. JP1 bypasses it on the bench.

g.desc: Fit a shorting plug, a remote-kill relay contact or a NC button in J KILL. JP1 bypasses it on the bench.

g.text: Shared driver signals: current-limit reference and fault wired-OR

g.desc: Shared driver signals: current-limit reference and fault wired-OR

g.text: VREF = 3.3 V x 33k/43k = 2.53 V -> ITRIP = VREF / (1.8k x 455 uA/A) = 3.1 A per motor.

g.desc: VREF = 3.3 V x 33k/43k = 2.53 V -> ITRIP = VREF / (1.8k x 455 uA/A) = 3.1 A per motor.

g.text: Vgs = -VBUS x 10k/14.7k (about -8.6 V at 12.6 V). Zener clamps Vgs. 1 uF Cgs slows turn-on (inrush ~4 A); nSLEEP gives the fast cut.

g.desc: Vgs = -VBUS x 10k/14.7k (about -8.6 V at 12.6 V). Zener clamps Vgs. 1 uF Cgs slows turn-on (inrush ~4 A); nSLEEP gives the fast cut.

g.text: ESP32 must toggle WDI at >25 Hz from its control loop. Q low = drivers asleep and VMOT off.

g.desc: ESP32 must toggle WDI at >25 Hz from its control loop. Q low = drivers asleep and VMOT off.
